arguments:
set -eu
repo=/srv/lowcost-europa
echo "GIT_SHA_BEGIN"
sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD
echo "COUNTRY_REFERENCES_FRONTEND"
sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 git -C "$repo" grep -nE 'ship_from_country|is_ship_from_verified|ALLOWED_SHIP_FROM_COUNTRIES' -- apps/storefront || echo "NO_EXPLICIT_FRONTEND_COUNTRY_QUERY"
echo "COUNTRY_REFERENCES_BACKEND"
sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 git -C "$repo" grep -lE 'ship_from_country|is_ship_from_verified|ALLOWED_SHIP_FROM_COUNTRIES' -- apps/catalog | head -n 30
echo "PROMISE_REFERENCES"
sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 git -C "$repo" grep -nEi '5 dias|2.?5 dias|pa[ií]ses permitidos|armaz[eé]m|stock garantido' -- apps/storefront/templates | head -n 45 || echo "NO_MATCH"
echo "SCHEDULE_STATE"
for unit in lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.timer lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.timer; do
systemctl is-active "$unit"
systemctl show "$unit" -p NextElapseUSecRealtime -p LastTriggerUSec --no-pager
done
echo "GIT_SHA_END"
